article.story: NEW ORLEANS -- — Jordan Pyke scored 15 points as Incarnate Word beat New Orleans 74-58 on Monday night, ending a six-game losing streak. Pyke also added eight rebounds for the Cardinals (10-11, 3-7 Southland Conference). Dylan Hayman totaled 14 points, seven rebounds and seven assists. Jayden Williams scored 14 on 7-for-8 shooting. James White led the Privateers (4-17, 2-8) with 15 points and three steals. Jah Short added 13 points and six assists. Michael Thomas pitched in with 10 points and six rebounds. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
